Product Recall and Contamination

In industries where safety and quality are non-negotiable, even a single contaminated or defective product can trigger a costly recall, regulatory scrutiny, and lasting reputational damage.

This is where Product Recall & Contamination Insurance kick in to help you respond quickly and recover confidently.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Product Recall and Contamination Insurance that covers the following:
• Loss or damage due to accidental contamination, malicious tampering, governmental recall, adverse publicity, and intentionally impaired ingredients.
• It also extends to cover products extortion, crisis containment, and regulatory body recall.

This product is applicable for industries involved in food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, restaurant chains, co-packers, toys, electrical goods, electronics, appliances, automotive, clothing and component parts.

What is the information needed for Product Recall and Contamination Insurance?
• Assured's Name
• Nature of Business/Profession
• Location
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
